summary.name: Grok API
summary.one_liner: Official API documentation for xAI's Grok models, covering chat, voice, image and video generation, and agentic coding.
use_cases: image and video generation or editing
summary.what_it_does: The page is the documentation hub for the Grok API, which offers models for code, text, voice, image, and video. It lists Grok 4.7 as the flagship model, with a 500k-token context window, agentic tool calling, configurable reasoning, and per-token pricing. It describes a Voice API for real-time conversations, speech-to-text (batch and streaming), and text-to-speech. It also describes an Imagine API for image generation and editing at 1K/2K and video at 480p/720p/1080p, with starting prices. A Responses API is listed for agentic coding, which powers Grok Build. A code example uses the Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/xai).
notable: Grok 4.7 with 500k-token context and configurable reasoning
Voice API covering real-time speech-to-speech, TTS, and STT
Imagine API for image and video generation and editing
Usable through the Vercel AI SDK via @ai-sdk/xai
caveats: Usage is billed per token, per minute, per character, or per image/second, so it is not free
Page header names the company 'SpaceXSI' and 'SpaceX Super Intelligence', which is not the xAI name used in the listing; the source is unclear
